answer: Anti-sybil via a fresh per-epoch compute puzzle bound to each identity. Every agent must solve a hash puzzle of 22 leading zero bits using the epoch seed before its answer counts, which takes about 4 minutes of CPU time and roughly 0.40 dollars of electricity per identity per epoch. An attacker spinning up 10,000 fake identities must therefore burn about 4,000 dollars and 28 days of single-core compute for every single epoch, while one honest agent pays only 0.40 dollars. The words are glacier, vault, haven.
